action.code: const slider = document.querySelector('input[type=range]'); if(slider) { slider.value = 0.3; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); }

const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]'); for(const s of sliders){ if(s.parentElement && s.parentElement.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('rough')){ s.value=0.8; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); break; }}
const cp = document.querySelector('input[type=color]'); if(cp){ cp.value='#ff4444'; cp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); }

const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]'); for(const s of sliders){ if(s.parentElement && s.parentElement.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('clearcoat') && !s.parentElement.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('roughness')){ s.value=0.6; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); break; }}
